name: Ulta Beauty
description: Ulta Beauty is the largest specialty beauty retailer in the US, selling cosmetics, skincare, haircare and fragrance from other companies' brands plus its own Ulta Beauty Collection, with a hair salon inside nearly every store. It operates 1,591 stores (1,505 Ulta in the US, 86 Space NK in the UK and Ireland), a Target shop-in-shop in over 600 Target locations, and a loyalty programme that drives most purchases. It reports one segment. FY2025 net sales were $12.4 billion (+9.7%) with a 39.1 percent gross margin, but operating income fell 2 percent to $1.53 billion (12.4 percent margin) as SG&A rose 17 percent to 26.6 percent of sales.
